name: jairf-builder-constraints
description: JAIRF builder system constraints roadmap (per 06_Builder_System_Constraints.md). Design goals: meaningful persistent content, protect performance/fairness, approachable-but-deep tool. Technical: piece/poly/draw-call/texture limits, snap grids (0.25/0.5/1m), rotation increments, height/ground-snap, overlap/collision rules, static physics. Safety: no path/quest blocking, no open-world combat advantage (arena-flag), ownership/permissions, versioning/rollback, moderation, auto-validation before publish. Persistence: server-side draft/published + version history. Performance safeguards: distance culling/LOD, in-builder budget warnings, server rejection. Future: scripted interactions, galleries, contests.

phases.name: 1. Budget limits (pieces, polys/draw calls, texture memory)
2. Placement rules (snap grid, rotation, height, overlap/collision)
3. Gameplay & safety rules (path/quest protection, arena flags)
6. Persistence: server save, draft/published, version history
7. Performance safeguards (culling, LOD, in-UI warnings, server rejection)
8. Future hooks: scripted interactions, galleries, contests
